sentences.en: The only useful answers are those that raise new questions.
sentences.zh: 只有提出新问题的回答才是有用的。

sentences.en: We heard the news that you had passed the exam.
sentences.zh: 我们听说你通过了考试的消息。

sentences.en: We need a new leader to pull our company together.
sentences.zh: 我们需要一位新的领导者来团结我们的公司。
